articles.title: 'Going bankrupt': Iran shopkeepers struggle as war dims demand
articles.description: Iran's economy has been battered by years of sanctions, but the conflict that began in February with US-Israeli attacks and an American blockade of the country's ports has put extra strain on daily life. Rising inflation, nearly 90 percent year-on-year in September according to official figures, and erratic currency exchange fluctuations have driven up the cost of everyday items. Food prices have more than doubled since last year.

articles.title: Ukraine ready to halt refinery strikes if Moscow stops energy attacks
articles.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Sunday said Kyiv was ready to halt strikes Russian oil refineries if Moscow stopped attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure. The announcement comes after US President Donald Trump publicly urged him to stop targeting Russian refineries.

articles.title: Trump, Zelensky clash over diesel deal as Russian strikes kill 21
articles.description: US President Donald Trump and Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelensky traded barbs Saturday after Washington moved to ease sanctions on Russian diesel and Moscow's continued strikes on Ukraine killed at least 21 people, including four children.

articles.description: Après le candidat de Renaissance Gabriel Attal, c'est au tour du candidat LFI de donner un meeting ce week-end. Le leader insoumis devrait consacrer une partie de son discours à la jeunesse.

articles.title: 🔴Pope Leo says will undergo surgery for early-stage lung nodule

Ils illustrent les tentatives de l’Etat de durcir l’accès aux documents historiques sensibles.

articles.description: Entre les difficultés à raccorder les derniers logements, le coût des réseaux ruraux et les malfaçons, l’achèvement de ce gigantesque chantier suscite des inquiétudes.

articles.title: Finlande : un modèle de "défense totale" qui mobilise toute la population en cas d'attaque russe

articles.title: "On essaye vraiment de trouver des solutions pour continuer" : à Paris, des lycéens préparent la suite du mouvement
